title: BAI Announces Advanced Coaches Course in Guwahati & Raipur
indian_angle: This course aims to enhance the skills of Indian badminton coaches, directly contributing to the development of future Indian talent.
summary: Badminton Association of India (BAI) is organizing a Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course at National Centers of Excellence in Guwahati and Raipur from September 14-23, 2026.

title: New Regulations Issued for Inter State Team Championships 2026
indian_angle: These regulations govern a key domestic team championship, shaping competition for Indian state teams and players.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has released the official regulations for the upcoming Inter State Team Championships 2026, outlining rules and guidelines for participating teams.

title: Women's Doubles Pair Change for World Junior Championships Trials
indian_angle: This update concerns a change in the lineup for selection trials, directly affecting which Indian women's doubles pair will represent the nation at the World Junior Championships.
summary: An important notification regarding a change in the Women's Doubles pair for the selection trials of the VICTOR BWF World Junior Championships 2026 has been issued by BAI.

title: Junior National Coaching Camp Underway in Guwahati
indian_angle: This coaching camp is crucial for preparing India's top U17 and U15 junior players for upcoming Badminton Asia Championships, fostering future national talent.
summary: A national coaching camp for the Indian team participating in the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026 is currently being held at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati.

title: Final Selection Trials List for World Junior Championships Announced
indian_angle: This announcement lists the Indian players who have qualified for the final trials to select the national squad for the prestigious BWF World Junior Championships.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has released the eligibility criteria and the list of players who have qualified for the final selection trials for the VICTOR BWF World Junior Championships 2026 in Cairo, Egypt.
